paragraphs.text: translated by
1. THE welcome speaker in the storm of battle uttered with might this prayer to win the Asvins,
paragraphs.original: इदमित्था रौद्रं गूर्तवचा ब्रह्म क्रत्वा शच्यामन्तराजौ ।
paragraphs.translit: idamitthā raudraṃ gūrtavacā brahma kratvā śacyāmantarājau |

paragraphs.text: When the most liberal God, for Paktha, rescued his parents, and assailed the seven Hotras.
paragraphs.original: क्राणा यदस्य पितरा मंहनेष्ठाः पर्षत्पक्थे अहन्ना सप्त होतॄन्
paragraphs.translit: krāṇā yadasya pitarā maṃhaneṣṭhāḥ parṣatpakthe ahannā sapta hotṝn

paragraphs.text: 2. Cyavana, purposing deceptive presents, with all ingredients, made the altar ready.
paragraphs.original: स इद्दानाय दभ्याय वन्वञ्च्यवानः सूदैरमिमीत वेदिम् ।
paragraphs.translit: sa iddānāya dabhyāya vanvañcyavānaḥ sūdairamimīta vedim |

paragraphs.text: Most sweet-voiced Turvayana poured oblations like floods of widely fertilizing water.
paragraphs.original: तूर्वयाणो गूर्तवचस्तमः क्षोदो न रेत इतऊति सिञ्चत्
paragraphs.translit: tūrvayāṇo gūrtavacastamaḥ kṣodo na reta itaūti siñcat

paragraphs.text: 3. To his oblations, swift as thought, ye hurried, and welcomed eagerly the prayers he offered.
paragraphs.original: मनो न येषु हवनेषु तिग्मं विपः शच्या वनुथो द्रवन्ता ।
paragraphs.translit: mano na yeṣu havaneṣu tigmaṃ vipaḥ śacyā vanutho dravantā |

paragraphs.text: With arrows in his hand the Very Mighty forced from him all obedience of a servant.
paragraphs.original: आ यः शर्याभिस्तुविनृम्णो अस्याश्रीणीतादिशं गभस्तौ
paragraphs.translit: ā yaḥ śaryābhistuvinṛmṇo asyāśrīṇītādiśaṃ gabhastau

paragraphs.text: 4. I call on you the Sons of Dyaus, the Asvins, that a dark cow to my red kine be added.
paragraphs.original: कृष्णा यद्गोष्वरुणीषु सीदद्दिवो नपाताश्विना हुवे वाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: kṛṣṇā yadgoṣvaruṇīṣu sīdaddivo napātāśvinā huve vām |

paragraphs.text: Enjoy my sacrifice, come to my viands contented, not deceiving expectation. '
paragraphs.original: वीतं मे यज्ञमा गतं मे अन्नं ववन्वांसा नेषमस्मृतध्रू
paragraphs.translit: vītaṃ me yajñamā gataṃ me annaṃ vavanvāṃsā neṣamasmṛtadhrū

paragraphs.text: 10. Uttering praise to suit the rite Navagvas came speedily to win the damsel's friendship.
paragraphs.original: मक्षू कनायाः सख्यं नवग्वा ऋतं वदन्त ऋतयुक्तिमग्मन् ।
paragraphs.translit: makṣū kanāyāḥ sakhyaṃ navagvā ṛtaṃ vadanta ṛtayuktimagman |

paragraphs.text: They who approached the twice-strong stable's keeper, meedless would milk the rocks that naught had shaken.
paragraphs.original: द्विबर्हसो य उप गोपमागुरदक्षिणासो अच्युता दुदुक्षन्
paragraphs.translit: dvibarhaso ya upa gopamāguradakṣiṇāso acyutā dudukṣan

paragraphs.text: 11. Swift was new friendship with the maid they quickly accepted it as genuine seed and bounty.
paragraphs.original: मक्षू कनायाः सख्यं नवीयो राधो न रेत ऋतमित्तुरण्यन् ।
paragraphs.translit: makṣū kanāyāḥ sakhyaṃ navīyo rādho na reta ṛtamitturaṇyan |

paragraphs.text: Milk which the cow Sabardugha had yielded was the bright heritage which to thee they offered.
paragraphs.original: शुचि यत्ते रेक्ण आयजन्त सबर्दुघायाः पय उस्रियायाः
paragraphs.translit: śuci yatte rekṇa āyajanta sabardughāyāḥ paya usriyāyāḥ

paragraphs.text: 12. When afterwards they woke- and missed the cattle, the speaker thus in joyful mood addressed them:
paragraphs.original: पश्वा यत्पश्चा वियुता बुधन्तेति ब्रवीति वक्तरी रराणः ।
paragraphs.translit: paśvā yatpaścā viyutā budhanteti bravīti vaktarī rarāṇaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Matchless are singers throulgh the Vasu's nature; he bringeth them all food and all possessions.
paragraphs.original: वसोर्वसुत्वा कारवोऽनेहा विश्वं विवेष्टि द्रविणमुप क्षु
paragraphs.translit: vasorvasutvā kāravo'nehā viśvaṃ viveṣṭi draviṇamupa kṣu

paragraphs.text: 13. His followers then who dwelt in sundry places came and desired too slay the son of Nrsad.
paragraphs.original: तदिन्न्वस्य परिषद्वानो अग्मन्पुरू सदन्तो नार्षदं बिभित्सन् ।
paragraphs.translit: tadinnvasya pariṣadvāno agmanpurū sadanto nārṣadaṃ bibhitsan |

paragraphs.text: Resistless foe, be found the hidden treasure of Susna multiplied in numerous offspring.
paragraphs.original: वि शुष्णस्य संग्रथितमनर्वा विदत्पुरुप्रजातस्य गुहा यत्
paragraphs.translit: vi śuṣṇasya saṃgrathitamanarvā vidatpuruprajātasya guhā yat

paragraphs.text: 14. Thou, called Effulgence, in whose threefold dwelling, as in the light of heaven, the Gods are sitting,
paragraphs.original: भर्गो ह नामोत यस्य देवाः स्वर्ण ये त्रिषधस्थे निषेदुः ।
paragraphs.translit: bhargo ha nāmota yasya devāḥ svarṇa ye triṣadhasthe niṣeduḥ |

paragraphs.text: Thou who art called Agni or Jatavedas, Priest, hear us, guileless Priest of holy worship.
paragraphs.original: अग्निर्ह नामोत जातवेदाः श्रुधी नो होतरृतस्य होताध्रुक्
paragraphs.translit: agnirha nāmota jātavedāḥ śrudhī no hotarṛtasya hotādhruk

paragraphs.text: 15. And, Indra, bring, that I may laud and serve them, those Two resplendent glorious Nasatyas,
paragraphs.original: उत त्या मे रौद्रावर्चिमन्ता नासत्याविन्द्र गूर्तये यजध्यै ।
paragraphs.translit: uta tyā me raudrāvarcimantā nāsatyāvindra gūrtaye yajadhyai |

paragraphs.text: Blithe, bounteous, man-like, to the sacrificer, honoured among our men with offered viands.
paragraphs.original: मनुष्वद्वृक्तबर्हिषे रराणा मन्दू हितप्रयसा विक्षु यज्यू
paragraphs.translit: manuṣvadvṛktabarhiṣe rarāṇā mandū hitaprayasā vikṣu yajyū

paragraphs.text: 16. This King is praised and honoured as Ordainer: himself the bridge, the Sage speeds o'er the waters.
paragraphs.original: अयं स्तुतो राजा वन्दि वेधा अपश्च विप्रस्तरति स्वसेतुः ।
paragraphs.translit: ayaṃ stuto rājā vandi vedhā apaśca viprastarati svasetuḥ |

paragraphs.text: He hath stirred up Kaksivan, stirred up Agni, as the steed's swift wheel drives the felly onward.
paragraphs.original: स कक्षीवन्तं रेजयत्सो अग्निं नेमिं न चक्रमर्वतो रघुद्रु
paragraphs.translit: sa kakṣīvantaṃ rejayatso agniṃ nemiṃ na cakramarvato raghudru

paragraphs.text: 17. Vaitarana, doubly kinsman, sacrificer, shall milk the cow who ne'er hath calved, Sabardhu,
paragraphs.original: स द्विबन्धुर्वैतरणो यष्टा सबर्धुं धेनुमस्वं दुहध्यै ।
paragraphs.translit: sa dvibandhurvaitaraṇo yaṣṭā sabardhuṃ dhenumasvaṃ duhadhyai |

paragraphs.text: When I encompass Varuna and Mitra with lauds, and Aryaman in safest shelter.
paragraphs.original: सं यन्मित्रावरुणा वृञ्ज उक्थैर्ज्येष्ठेभिरर्यमणं वरूथैः
paragraphs.translit: saṃ yanmitrāvaruṇā vṛñja ukthairjyeṣṭhebhiraryamaṇaṃ varūthaiḥ

paragraphs.text: 18. Their kin, the Prince in heaven, thy nearest kinsman, turning his thought to thee thus speaks in kindness:
paragraphs.original: तद्बन्धुः सूरिर्दिवि ते धियंधा नाभानेदिष्ठो रपति प्र वेनन् ।
paragraphs.translit: tadbandhuḥ sūrirdivi te dhiyaṃdhā nābhānediṣṭho rapati pra venan |

paragraphs.text: This is our highest bond: I am his offspring. How many others came ere I succeeded?
paragraphs.original: सा नो नाभिः परमास्य वा घाहं तत्पश्चा कतिथश्चिदास
paragraphs.translit: sā no nābhiḥ paramāsya vā ghāhaṃ tatpaścā katithaścidāsa

paragraphs.text: 19. Here is my kinship, here the place I dwell in: these are my Gods; I in full strength am present.
paragraphs.original: इयं मे नाभिरिह मे सधस्थमिमे मे देवा अयमस्मि सर्वः ।
paragraphs.translit: iyaṃ me nābhiriha me sadhasthamime me devā ayamasmi sarvaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Twice-born am I, the first-born Son of Order: the Cow milked this when first she had her being.
paragraphs.original: द्विजा अह प्रथमजा ऋतस्येदं धेनुरदुहज्जायमाना
paragraphs.translit: dvijā aha prathamajā ṛtasyedaṃ dhenuraduhajjāyamānā

paragraphs.text: 20. So mid these tribes he rests, the friendly envoy, borne on two paths, refulgent Lord of fuel.
paragraphs.original: अधासु मन्द्रो अरतिर्विभावाव स्यति द्विवर्तनिर्वनेषाट् ।
paragraphs.translit: adhāsu mandro aratirvibhāvāva syati dvivartanirvaneṣāṭ |

paragraphs.text: When, like a line, the Babe springs up erectly, his Mother straight hath borne him strong to bless us.
paragraphs.original: ऊर्ध्वा यच्छ्रेणिर्न शिशुर्दन्मक्षू स्थिरं शेवृधं सूत माता
paragraphs.translit: ūrdhvā yacchreṇirna śiśurdanmakṣū sthiraṃ śevṛdhaṃ sūta mātā

paragraphs.text: 21. Then went the milch-kine forth to please the damsel, and for the good of every man that liveth.
paragraphs.original: अधा गाव उपमातिं कनाया अनु श्वान्तस्य कस्य चित्परेयुः ।
paragraphs.translit: adhā gāva upamātiṃ kanāyā anu śvāntasya kasya citpareyuḥ |

paragraphs.text: Hear us, O wealthy Lord; begin our worship. Thou hast grown mighty through Asvaghna's virtues.
paragraphs.original: श्रुधि त्वं सुद्रविणो नस्त्वं याळाश्वघ्नस्य वावृधे सूनृताभिः
paragraphs.translit: śrudhi tvaṃ sudraviṇo nastvaṃ yāḷāśvaghnasya vāvṛdhe sūnṛtābhiḥ

paragraphs.text: 22. And take thou notice of us also, Indra, for ample riches, King whose arm wields thunder!
paragraphs.original: अध त्वमिन्द्र विद्ध्यस्मान्महो राये नृपते वज्रबाहुः ।
paragraphs.translit: adha tvamindra viddhyasmānmaho rāye nṛpate vajrabāhuḥ |

paragraphs.text: Protect our wealthy nobles, guard our princes unmenaced near thee, Lord of Tawny Coursers.
paragraphs.original: रक्षा च नो मघोनः पाहि सूरीननेहसस्ते हरिवो अभिष्टौ
paragraphs.translit: rakṣā ca no maghonaḥ pāhi sūrīnanehasaste harivo abhiṣṭau

paragraphs.text: 23. When he goes forth, ye Pair of Kings, for booty, speeding to war and praise to please the singer,-
paragraphs.original: अध यद्राजाना गविष्टौ सरत्सरण्युः कारवे जरण्युः ।
paragraphs.translit: adha yadrājānā gaviṣṭau saratsaraṇyuḥ kārave jaraṇyuḥ |

paragraphs.text: I was the dearest sage of those about him,-let him lead these away and bring them safely.
paragraphs.original: विप्रः प्रेष्ठः स ह्येषां बभूव परा च वक्षदुत पर्षदेनान्
paragraphs.translit: vipraḥ preṣṭhaḥ sa hyeṣāṃ babhūva parā ca vakṣaduta parṣadenān

paragraphs.text: 24. Now for this noble man's support and comfort, singing with easy voice we thus implore thee:
paragraphs.original: अधा न्वस्य जेन्यस्य पुष्टौ वृथा रेभन्त ईमहे तदू नु ।
paragraphs.translit: adhā nvasya jenyasya puṣṭau vṛthā rebhanta īmahe tadū nu |

paragraphs.text: Impetuous be his son and fleet his courser: and may I be his priest to win him glory.
paragraphs.original: सरण्युरस्य सूनुरश्वो विप्रश्चासि श्रवसश्च सातौ
paragraphs.translit: saraṇyurasya sūnuraśvo vipraścāsi śravasaśca sātau

paragraphs.text: 25. If, for our strength, the priest with adoration to win your friendship made the laud accepted,
paragraphs.original: युवोर्यदि सख्यायास्मे शर्धाय स्तोमं जुजुषे नमस्वान् ।
paragraphs.translit: yuvoryadi sakhyāyāsme śardhāya stomaṃ jujuṣe namasvān |

paragraphs.text: That laud shall be a branching road to virtue for every one to whom the songs are suited.
paragraphs.original: विश्वत्र यस्मिन्ना गिरः समीचीः पूर्वीव गातुर्दाशत्सूनृतायै
paragraphs.translit: viśvatra yasminnā giraḥ samīcīḥ pūrvīva gāturdāśatsūnṛtāyai

paragraphs.text: 26. Glorified thus, with holy hymns and homage:-Of noble race, with Waters, God-attended
paragraphs.original: स गृणानो अद्भिर्देववानिति सुबन्धुर्नमसा सूक्तैः ।
paragraphs.translit: sa gṛṇāno adbhirdevavāniti subandhurnamasā sūktaiḥ |

paragraphs.text: May he enrich us for our prayers and praises: now can the cow be milked; the path is open.
paragraphs.original: वर्धदुक्थैर्वचोभिरा हि नूनं व्यध्वैति पयस उस्रियायाः
paragraphs.translit: vardhadukthairvacobhirā hi nūnaṃ vyadhvaiti payasa usriyāyāḥ

paragraphs.text: 27. Be to us, then, ye Gods who merit worship, be ye of one accord our strong protection,
paragraphs.original: त ऊ षु णो महो यजत्रा भूत देवास ऊतये सजोषाः ।
paragraphs.translit: ta ū ṣu ṇo maho yajatrā bhūta devāsa ūtaye sajoṣāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Who went on various ways and brought us vigour, ye who are undeceivable explorers.
paragraphs.original: ये वाजाँ अनयता वियन्तो ये स्था निचेतारो अमूराः
paragraphs.translit: ye vājām̐ anayatā viyanto ye sthā nicetāro amūrāḥ
